purpose: Test whether DO+serialized alpha-beta can improve strength/cost, not merely reduce full-matrix work. Do not infer universal hopelessness from finite tests.
information: Perfect information for BOTH arms; shared deterministic team preview. No blind-product superiority claim.
teams: 24-team current catalog, uniform draw; standard seed-paired side-swapped duel.
selection: Sample equilibrium strategy; alpha-beta uses iterative deepening, completed depth fallback, total 100000 engine executions per choice. No wall-time cutoffs (600s watchdog is an error).
mcts: RmAgent UCB c=0.4, all other current defaults incl rollout and action guards; wrappers bypass only common preview and forced choices.
correctness: Copied analysis-only solver; synthetic exhaustive tests, plus eval and frozen NN at 3 selected roots x 2 depths vs full-matrix values and strategy guarantees; require 1e-7.
timing: Mean/p50/p95/p99 for non-preview, non-forced decisions; includes iterative deepening, allocation, ordering and fallback. Native 4-worker paired arena; not browser latency. Standard harness also retains all-choice means.
selection_for_confirmation: At most two candidate schedules with largest score minus log-time interpolation of the measured MCTS common-reference curve. Below smallest baseline cost use the smallest rung as a conservative comparator. Selection is exploratory only. Freeze selected configurations before fresh results.

confirmation.mcts_budget: floor to multiple of 50 of 0.9 * 3000 * candidate_time/reference_time from screen; clamp [50,27000]. Determined only by cost, before confirmation outcomes.
confirmation.rule: Report actual cost ratio. If reference is >10% slower or >25% faster, one timing-only budget correction followed by a fresh fixed 256-game test is allowed; never merge the mismatched batch into a matched-cost conclusion.
confirmation.statistics: 95% normal CI on independent side-swap block means; report all selected candidates and selection history. Caps remain unresolved, with worst-case score bounds. No outcome-based stopping within any batch.

interpretation: A fresh direct win with comparable cost is evidence of potential; a loss to a cheaper MCTS is a dominated tested setting. Equal scores with overlapping intervals are inconclusive, not equivalence. Common-reference frontier is conditional on that opponent.
next_scope: If a fully observed candidate looks promising, determine whether a bounded blind follow-up is needed to answer the product relevance; no publishing or production default changes.

secondary_depth_coverage_amendment.when: After screen-05, before eval depth3, net depth3, net16x4 and mcts10000 results. No confirmation outcomes exist.
secondary_depth_coverage_amendment.reason: Depth-one DO candidates do not invoke serialized subtree alpha-beta, so confirming only depth-one frontier candidates cannot answer whether deeper alpha-beta is useful.
secondary_depth_coverage_amendment.rule: Preserve original two selections. If both have depth one, add the highest-residual depth>=2 candidate as a separate 256-game fresh-seed secondary confirmation using the same cost-matching formula. Report it separately; no change to primary selection or evidence.

depth_definition: One level is one joint apply_choices decision transition, including forced replacement decisions; it is not necessarily a complete battle turn.

close_match_validation_amendment.when: After shallow primary confirmations, before first inspecting deep confirmation-02 results. Last inspected deep progress was 170/256; its completion was first observed in the command output after the amendment was written.
close_match_validation_amendment.reason: The original allowed cost band was asymmetric; a win while spending ~30% more cannot resolve equal-cost performance. A closer timing comparison is necessary for the requested frontier judgment.
close_match_validation_amendment.rule: After original confirmations and their allowed correction, for any selected setting whose actual candidate/reference mean-time ratio is outside [0.9,1.1], run one additional fixed 256-game batch. Reference iterations = nearest 10 to old iterations * observed time ratio, clamped [50,27000]. Fresh seed 2026101430 + selection index. No performance-based choice and no pooling. Report all batches and any remaining mismatch.
